subject: Clarify 'no training' claim and retention windows for logs/recordings
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@ezbank.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@ezbank.com
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify: "we do not train on customer data" + retention details

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Quick Q from our InfoSec review: your public docs say "we do not use customer-provided content to train model weights." Can you confirm that applies to all hosted API traffic, logs, and recorded call transcripts? We also need clarity on default retention windows (requests, responses, logs, and any cold backups) and how deletion requests are executed (time-to-delete, backup windows, verification).

We need short, explicit answers we can pass to legal and the board (bullet points are best). If you have a short evidence packet (SOC/attestation, deletion flow diagram, sample contract language) that would be ideal.

Thanks —
Alice
Alice Jenkins
Head of Cloud Security, EZ Bank
alice.jenkins@ezbank.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0198

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@ezbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify: "we do not train on customer data" + retention details

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers first, then a few bullets with nuance.

Short answers (TL;DR)
- We do not use customer-provided prompts, files, responses, or transcripts to train or update any of our base or customer-facing models by default.
- Default request/response logs for hosted API are retained 30 days and then purged; retention can be shortened or disabled on Dedicated/Private deployments per contract.
- Backups/cold snapshots may require up to 90 days for full purging due to replication and archival windows; we provide certification of deletion once purge completes.

Key details / nuance
- "Not used for training": Customer content is excluded from our model training pipelines unless there is an explicit opt-in program (we notify and obtain contract-level consent). We do not surface customer text into model fine-tuning or base-model re-training flows.
- Telemetry & metrics: Non-content telemetry (latency, error rates, token counts) is aggregated and used for product improvements. This telemetry is not tied to raw customer content.
- Ephemeral caches: KV caches used for active requests are ephemeral and are not persisted beyond session lifetimes unless explicitly configured for debugging; any debugging retention is limited and documented.
- Deletion workflow: Upon a deletion request we (1) flag the tenant's data for immediate removal from active stores, (2) trigger background purge jobs to remove logs and caches, and (3) schedule retention-policy expirations for archived snapshots. For hosted plans we guarantee a confirmation of deletion within 30 days; for Dedicated/Private we will define the SLA in contract.
- Legal exceptions: We will comply with legal holds/subpoenas; those are processed through our Trust & Safety and Legal teams and will be notified to the customer.

Evidence packet attached: SOC2-Attestation.pdf (summary of controls), Data-Deletion-Playbook.pdf, Deletion-Flow-Diagram.png.

Next steps
- If you'd like, we can provide sample contract language (no-training clause + deletion SLA) and set up a 30-minute call this week to walk through the playbook.

Regards,
Sojin Lee
Head of Security & Compliance (assigned)
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@ezbank.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify: "we do not train on customer data" + retention details

Alice — adding a couple legal/contract points to Soojin's technical summary:

- Contract language we commonly offer: "Seller shall not use Customer Content to train, improve, or otherwise modify Seller's models or models of third parties without Customer's prior written consent." We can include specific carve-outs for aggregated/anonymous telemetry if you prefer.
- Deletion SLA: we can commit to a 30-day deletion confirmation for hosted customers; for Dedicated we can contract a 7-30 day SLA depending on configuration and agreed cold-storage purge windows.
- Backups: technical purge can take up to 90 days due to replication and immutable snapshot windows; contract language includes an obligation to notify customer and provide attestation when backups are removed.
- Audit: we can add audit evidence (timestamped deletion log + internal ticket id) to the contract appendix for regulated customers.

I'll draft sample language and share a short redline you can send to procurement/legal. Jordan, please confirm if you'd like me to open a DocuSign envelope with the draft clause.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
